cards.title: Patient Zero
cards.rules: You're infected: until the cure, you only speak in questions. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Pirate Flu
cards.rules: You're infected: until the cure, you talk like a pirate. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Narrator Virus
cards.rules: You're infected: until the cure, you talk about yourself in the third person. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Lockjaw
cards.rules: You're infected: until the cure, nobody sees your teeth. Laugh with them showing: drink 1.

cards.title: Ex Syndrome
cards.rules: You're infected: until the cure, you call everyone 'my ex'. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Royal Pox
cards.rules: You're infected: until the cure, you call everyone Your Majesty. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Toddler Virus
cards.rules: You're infected: until the cure, you say 'why?' to anything said to you. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Left-Hand Plague
cards.rules: You're infected: until the cure, you drink with your left hand only. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Live Grenade
cards.rules: A grenade is rolling around the next ten cards. Whoever draws it finishes their drink.

cards.title: Silent but Deadly
cards.rules: Someone dropped a silent one. It hits within ten cards. Whoever draws it drinks 4.

cards.title: Time Bomb
cards.rules: A bomb is ticking somewhere in the next ten cards. Its drawer and both neighbors pay.

cards.title: Payday Loan
cards.rules: Give 4 now. The loan comes back with interest soon.

cards.title: IOU
cards.rules: Point at someone. They owe you a drink, and it comes due soon.

cards.title: Hangover Insurance
cards.rules: Drink 2 now. Your future self gets a refund.

cards.title: Remember This
cards.rules: The table picks one silly word together. Remember it: a pop quiz is coming.

cards.title: Calling It
cards.rules: Point at who'll be drunkest ten minutes from now. The table remembers.

cards.title: Cliffhanger
cards.rules: Start a story about your worst night out and stop mid-sentence. It comes back.

cards.title: Grudge
cards.rules: Name someone here you have beef with. Don't say why. It gets settled soon.

cards.title: Rain Check
cards.rules: You're owed a waterfall, not now. It comes back to you soon.

cards.title: Sealed Envelope
cards.rules: Predict out loud who drinks next. You'll be checked soon.

cards.title: Quarantine
cards.rules: Until your next turn, nobody may touch you. Anyone who does drinks 2.

cards.title: Hand Sanitizer
cards.rules: Everyone who hasn't washed their hands since they got here drinks 2.

cards.title: Sneeze Guard
cards.rules: Fake a sneeze at the table. Everyone who flinches drinks 1.

cards.title: Super Spreader
cards.rules: You touched everything. Point at three people. Each drinks 1.

cards.title: Symptoms
cards.rules: Everyone who's hungover right now drinks 2. You know who you are.

cards.title: Patient History
cards.rules: Tell the table the dumbest way you've ever gotten sick. Everyone drinks 2.

cards.title: The Cure
cards.rules: Patient Zero is cured. Everyone who caught them slipping drinks 2 to their health.

cards.title: Scurvy Cured
cards.rules: The pirate is cured. They drink 2 to celebrate, matey.

cards.title: First Person
cards.rules: The narrator is cured. Everyone they annoyed gives them 1.

cards.title: Jaw Unlocked
cards.rules: Lockjaw is cured. They flash the table a big grin, then drink 2.

cards.title: Closure
cards.rules: The ex-caller is cured. Everyone they called an ex drinks 1.

cards.title: Revolution
cards.rules: The royal pox is cured. Everyone they bowed to drinks 2.

cards.title: Grown Up
cards.rules: The toddler is cured. They explain taxes in one sentence, then drink 2.

cards.title: Right Hand Back
cards.rules: The left-hand plague is cured. They give 3 to whoever caught them most.

cards.title: Boom
cards.rules: The grenade lands on you. Finish your drink. Anyone who flinched drinks 1.

cards.title: It Hit You
cards.rules: The silent one found you. Drink 4 and fan the table.

cards.title: Kaboom
cards.rules: The bomb goes off. You and both your neighbors drink 3.

cards.title: Collections
cards.rules: Collections. Whoever took the Payday Loan drinks 6. Interest is a bitch.

cards.title: Debt Due
cards.rules: The IOU is due. Whoever owes it drinks 3 and thanks the lender.

cards.title: Refund
cards.rules: The insurance pays out. Whoever bought it gives 4.

cards.title: Pop Quiz
cards.rules: On 3, everyone says the word from Remember This. Wrong or blank drinks 3.

cards.title: Called It?
cards.rules: The table votes on the pick from Calling It. Right, the caller gives 4. Wrong, drinks 4.

cards.title: To Be Continued
cards.rules: Whoever told the Cliffhanger finishes the story now. Bore the table: drink 3.

cards.title: Grudge Match
cards.rules: The Grudge is settled: those two thumb war. Loser drinks 3.

cards.title: Waterfall Due
cards.rules: The Rain Check is due. Whoever holds it starts a waterfall now.

cards.title: Envelope Opened
cards.rules: The table rules on the Sealed Envelope. Right, its writer gives 3. Wrong, drinks 3.
